test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Litrature.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Litrature"** is incorrectly spelled and should be** "Literature"**. (साहित्य)
 
• **"Literature" **refers to written works, especially those considered of superior or lasting artistic merit. (साहित्य)
 
 
• **Example: **She is studying English literature at the university.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Litrature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reformation **(सुधार): The action or process of reforming an institution or practice.

 
 
• **Example:** The reformation of the education system is a priority for the government.
 
 
 
• **Schedule **(अनुसूची): A plan for carrying out a process or procedure, giving lists of intended events and times.
 
 
• **Example: **The train schedule was posted on the bulletin board.
 
 
 
• **Miserable** (दुखी): Wretchedly unhappy or uncomfortable.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt miserable after losing her job.
